title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — Enrollment and One Service per Employer
content:
**Clause 1.** An employer holds at most 1 Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service for all of its locations.

**Clause 2.** An employer may not hold a second disbursement service that is not closed.

**Clause 3.** A new service opens in pending setup at the tier whose monthly disbursement band contains the employer's expected monthly disbursement count, with a zero balance, with automatic replenishment off unless the employer authorizes it, and with its low-balance alert at the tier's default alert level unless the employer sets another.

## Evidence for Clause 2

Whether the employer already holds a service, and the status of that service, is taken from Paystride's own service records for that employer, read before the enrollment is made; the employer's statement does not decide it. A service in pending setup, active or suspended status is a service that is not closed. Each service is its own record, told apart from the employer's other services by its enrollment date.

## Status of an existing service and a new enrollment

| The employer's existing service is | A second service may be opened |
|---|---|
| pending setup | no |
| active | no |
| suspended | no |
| closed | Clause 2 does not bar it |

## Opening state of a new service

| Item | Opening value |
|---|---|
| Status | pending setup |
| Tier | the tier whose band contains the expected monthly disbursement count |
| Prefund balance | zero |
| Automatic replenishment | off, unless the employer authorizes it |
| Low-balance alert | the tier's default alert level, unless the employer sets another |

**Hypothetical illustration.** An employer expecting 300 disbursements a month and choosing no alert level opens in pending setup on the tier whose band takes in 300, with a zero balance, automatic replenishment off and that tier's default alert level.
